**AllCoreDevs in 40 mins (April 1, 14:00 UTC)**
Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/500
Stream: https://youtu.be/1QU8r9-SJDc
Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
Re: the CFI discussion. **Would any client team be opposed to holding off from adding new CFI EIPs until we're at least deploying The Merge on existing testnets?** It does seem to take some time on the calls and set the expectation to the community that now is the time to come and advocate for EIPs, while we don't have a ton of bandwidth to consider them, and haven't begun implementing the existing CFI EIPs (nor have we finished implementing all the merge fixes 😅). 

In order to not take up 5-10 minutes on the next ACD to discuss this, if we get all client teams to react to this message with their logo, I will consider that we want to hold off further CFI discussions until after merge testnets are well underway. No worries if we'd rather have the conversation on the next ACD!

excerpts.author: ryanleeschneider
excerpts.content: oh, was there discussion on the order of merging the testnets?

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: <@!388751025789468672> not the order, but how long we should let each one sit after the upgrade before moving to the next one

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: we didn't discuss rinkeby specifically, but it's my understanding we won't be merging it

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: the only thing w.r.t. order is that it might make sense to have Sepolia in the middle of Goerli & Ropsten, so that the two which have the highest usage are longest apart in case something goes wrong on the first, but it wasn't decided either way
